checkedAlternates.risk: Egg tempera is thinned with water during painting.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Egg tempera’s binder is egg yolk protein (group-2), unlike gum arabic or acrylic polymer (group-4).

checkedAlternates.risk: Acrylic can mimic thick oil impasto.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Acrylic uses a water-dispersed synthetic polymer emulsion (group-4), not a drying oil (group-3).
